headline: High Court Warns Panchayats
summary: The High Court has warned the Goa Directorate of Panchayats over delays in establishing PoSH committees. The directive emphasizes the urgent need for compliance across local bodies.

headline: CCTV Policy for Panchayats
summary: The Goa government has drafted a new CCTV retention policy requiring village bodies to install five cameras each. The move aims to enhance local security and monitoring.

headline: Goa Narcotics Network Busted
summary: Telangana Police and EAGLE Force arrested three individuals and seized Rs 1.5 lakh worth of drugs. The operation successfully busted a narcotics supply network operating out of Goa.

headline: Three Arrested in Goa Drug Raid
summary: Three suspects from Goa were apprehended for supplying drugs in a joint operation by external and local law enforcement. The arrests highlight ongoing inter-state efforts against narcotics.

headline: CJP Distances From Protest Slogans
summary: Citizens for Justice and Peace in Goa has distanced itself from anti-Hindutva slogans raised during a recent protest in Panaji. The clarification came following warnings of strict action by the chief minister.

headline: Congress Demands DGP Probe
summary: The Congress party has strongly condemned the anti-Hindu slogans chanted during a recent protest. They have demanded a thorough investigation led by the DGP.

headline: Rs 900-Crore Cyber Scam Busted
summary: Law enforcement arrested 12 young men operating an alleged multi-crore cyber fraud network from a luxury villa in Candolim. The massive racket is estimated to involve around Rs 900 crore.

headline: Porvorim Shootout Investigation
summary: The Goa Crime Branch is actively probing potential deeper links and associates connected to the accused in the Porvorim shootout. Authorities are reviewing background ties to uncover the full conspiracy.

headline: Mizoram Leader Meets Youth
summary: Mizoram leader Lalduhoma interacted with visiting youth delegates from Goa and Chandigarh. The meeting took place during a regional exchange program.

headline: Deadline Set for Kul-Mundkar Cases
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has set a strict December 19 deadline to resolve all pending Kul-Mundkar cases. Authorities have been directed to fast-track these land tenure disputes.

headline: Congress Demands CM Resignation
summary: The opposition Congress party has demanded the chief minister's resignation over the cash-for-jobs scam. They are also pressing for a court-monitored Special Investigation Team probe.

headline: New ESI Medical College Approved
summary: The central government has approved a new ESI Medical College for Goa, which will include 25 reserved seats for local residents. This marks a major boost to the state's medical education infrastructure.

headline: Second Government Medical College Cleared
summary: Goa has received clearance from the Centre for its second government medical college, featuring 50 seats starting in the 2027-28 academic session. The project aims to significantly expand healthcare training in the state.

headline: Bengaluru to North Goa Road Guide
summary: Travel enthusiasts have shared updated routes, key stopping points, and overall road conditions for driving from Bengaluru to North Goa. The guide aims to assist holidaymakers planning road trips.

headline: Panaji Swelters Above 37°C
summary: Panaji recorded temperatures exceeding 37°C for the second consecutive day, marking one of the hottest October spells in nearly two decades. Meteorological officials expect relief soon.

headline: Telangana Edges Goa in Hockey
summary: Telangana narrowly defeated Goa 3-2 in a tightly contested match at the Hockey India Men’s National Championship. Both teams displayed competitive skills throughout the encounter.

headline: Cordelia Sky Arrives in Mumbai
summary: The cruise liner Cordelia Sky has docked in Mumbai and is scheduled to begin upcoming passenger voyages to destinations including Goa and Lakshadweep. The sailings cater to regional luxury tourism.

headline: Insights From Goa Spring Census
summary: Recent findings from the spring census have highlighted key demographic and ecological shifts across Goa. Environmentalists and researchers are analyzing the data.

headline: Congress Slams State Financial State
summary: The Congress party has accused the ruling BJP government of driving Goa into a severe financial crisis. They pointed to mounting debt and fiscal mismanagement.

headline: Police Transfer Personnel to ANC
summary: The Goa Police Headquarters has transferred 14 personnel to the Anti-Narcotics Cell with immediate effect. The reshuffle is part of ongoing efforts to strengthen anti-drug operations.

headline: New Flights to Goa and Bengaluru
summary: Airlines have announced new direct flight connections linking Chandigarh to Bengaluru and Goa starting December 1. The enhanced connectivity is expected to boost winter holiday travel.

headline: Special Dasara Train Announced
summary: South Western Railway has announced a special Dasara train connecting Bengaluru and Goa. However, the omission of Mangaluru from the route has left several passengers disappointed.

headline: Power Shortage Linked to Heatwave
summary: Power Minister Sudin Dhavalikar attributed recent power shortages in Goa to a combination of intense heatwaves and wet coal impacting generation. Authorities are working to stabilize the grid.

headline: Fatal Accident at Infrastructure Site
summary: A worker tragically lost his life after falling onto exposed iron rods at an ongoing infrastructure development site. Local authorities have initiated a probe into workplace safety compliance.

headline: Makeover for Viceroy Portraits
summary: The ASI museum in Goa has given 120 historic portraits of Portuguese viceroys a chronological makeover. The revamped display offers visitors a clearer historical timeline.

headline: New Health Centre Planned for Sada
summary: Construction for the new Headland-Sada health centre is officially scheduled for completion by January 2028. The facility will upgrade healthcare access for local residents.

headline: Row Over Deleted Voter Entries
summary: Congress leader Girish Chodankar has labeled the SIR electoral roll revision unconstitutional following the reported omission of numerous Goan voters. The Election Commission maintained that the rolls are de-novo.

headline: Industrial Plot Scheme Brings Investment
summary: A state initiative aimed at unlocking idle industrial plots has successfully generated Rs 165.3 crore in fresh investments. The policy seeks to boost manufacturing and industrial growth in Goa.

headline: Goy Rakhon Yatra Boosts Congress
summary: The Goy Rakhon Yatra has given the Congress party renewed momentum, though political analysts note that achieving broader electoral change remains a steep challenge.

headline: Rubina Dilaik Talks Responsible Tourism
summary: Television personality Rubina Dilaik recently shared her fondness for Goa, balancing motherhood, and her advocacy for responsible tourism. She emphasized the importance of preserving local ecosystems.

headline: Plan to Relocate Beach Dogs Opposed
summary: Animal welfare advocates have strongly opposed the tourism department's proposal to relocate stray dogs from state beaches. Critics argue for humane management solutions instead of removal.

headline: Advocates Protest Revenue Office Delays
summary: Legal advocates in South Goa staged protests against persistent delays and alleged corruption in local revenue offices. The demonstration called for immediate administrative reforms.

headline: Voter Awareness Drive for 2027 Polls
summary: Authorities have planned a targeted voter awareness campaign for Kushavati constituents ahead of the upcoming 2027 Goa assembly elections. The initiative aims to improve turnout and electoral participation.

headline: SRFTI Partnership for Film Fest
summary: The Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute is set to provide enhanced exposure and learning opportunities for students and faculty at the upcoming Goa film festival.

headline: Saligao Waste Plant Suspends Intake
summary: The Saligao waste management plant has temporarily suspended taking in waste from eight local bodies for a duration of 25 days. Municipalities have been advised to make alternative arrangements.

headline: Marine Science Spotlighted at NIO
summary: The National Institute of Oceanography in Goa celebrated its Foundation Day with glowing bacteria displays and microbial art. The exhibits aimed to make marine science more engaging for the public.

headline: CM Assures Dog-Free Beaches
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant assured that there will be no stray dog menace on state beaches during the upcoming tourism season. Adequate measures are being implemented to ensure visitor comfort.
